title: Controlled interrupted time series (intervention against control series)
summary: Level and slope changes relative to a control series, which removes changes that hit both sites at the intervention date.
pinned_defaults: Both: segmented regression of the difference series (intervention minus control); equal to the group-by-period coefficients of the full interaction model on the stacked series.
Both: Newey-West covariance at lag 3, Bartlett weights, no pre-whitening, no adjustment.
_why_control: A shared drop of 2 at the intervention month: the single-series analysis reports about -6, the controlled one about -4.
